Export, quantize and run end-to-end every transformers model, on any backend: same inputs, same outputs, drop-in replacement. 👇

Faster than torch.compile. with EmbeddingGemma2, 8 × 128 tokens:
- Xeon Platinum 8570: Intel OpenVINO 4.1× eager PyTorch, while torch.compile is 1.9×, up to 4.9× with NNCF int8 quantization.
- A100: ONNX Runtime TensorRT EP 7.6× eager PyTorch, while torch.compile is 5.4×, up to 9x with NVIDIA ModelOpt int8 quantization.

1. Export: One API for Dynamo, ONNX, OpenVINO and PyTorch ExecuTorch, dynamic shapes with one flag, automatic operator fusions !

2. Quantize as part of the export: pass a quantizer to the config.
PT2E on any backend, NNCF on OpenVINO and ONNX, and ONNX Runtime's or ModelOpt quantizers.

3. Push to the Hub like any other model: the graph, its metadata and the model config, in one repo.

4. Load it and call it on the backend's own runtime. On ONNX Runtime that could be CUDA, TensorRT, OpenVINO, CoreML or any other execution provider. On Executorch you can run your favorite model on XNNPACK, MLX, WebGPU or any other delegate.

Docs: https://lnkd.in/ez9BJYjd 
Release notes: https://lnkd.in/eZAi-VWn
